title: Davidson third hate corpus descriptive transport
question: 在 TweetEval/hate 与 HateXplain 之外，R12 / rescan 在 Davidson 第三个 hate 语料上，按 default 阈值是否仍能保持 f32 的 accuracy/macro-F1？M1.42 已否定 fit-only 阈值搬运，因此本轮不测 target_prior，只做 descriptive transport。

dataset.name: Davidson et al. 2017 hate speech and offensive language

label_mapping.note: binary primary only; three-class is not part of M1.45.

preprocessing: deduplicate by normalized text, keep first occurrence (1 duplicate removed)
no official split; fixed stratified 80/20 split, random_state=7, stratify by binary label
remove test rows whose exact normalized text appears in TweetEval/hate train+test or HateXplain train+test (1 row removed)
dataset.note: No official split exists. The 80/20 split is fixed before model scores and is a descriptive external transport check, not a confirmatory claim about the original corpus population.

modeling.c_selection: f32 only, 5-fold StratifiedKFold on fit, accuracy; f32 and quantized arm share C

primary.verdict: descriptive only; report positive/negative/cross counts but do not confirm or reject a candidate
primary.reason: third corpus, no official split, binary mapping collapses offensive+neither, and only 285 hate test rows; insufficient for a confirmatory candidate claim

secondary: macro-F1 arm - f32, point estimate only
C values and predicted positive rates
exclusions: no target_prior / fit-only threshold (M1.42 already closed that line)
no MLP, no encoder fine-tuning, no MNLI
